clips.title: The story
paras: Forest Song watches over northeastern Ashenvale, near Satyrnaar and Bough Shadow. The ancient kaldorei ruins are largely deserted, with the druid Kayneth Stillwind guarding the eastern border.

Forest Song's white columns and broken arches rise among the trees of northeastern Ashenvale. Once an elegant kaldorei settlement, the ruin now lies overgrown with ivy and wild ferns. Satyrnaar lies to the southwest, and the Warsong Lumber Camp presses in from the south. From here, eastern trails lead toward Azshara and Bough Shadow. Demonic corruption and Horde incursions trouble the surrounding woods, while the ruins remain quiet.

Kayneth Stillwind keeps watch over Forest Song alone. From the crumbling outpost, the druid watches for enemies entering the wilderness, including the Forsaken in the eastern forests. Astranaar lies far away, and Forest Song has no garrison fortifications. Still, Alliance travelers heading north toward Felwood or seeking the corruption spreading through the canopy can gather here.
